QuestInfo.name: [Epic Dungeon] In Peculiar Company
QuestInfo.0:
Mitra freed the fragment of the sealed Tynos and recovered his power. At that moment, he ran into Seren, who came to High Mountain to repair Azor.

Seren had a hunch that something unusual was happening in High Mountain, and followed Mitra.
